versions.changelog:
Initial release of the neurology-pmph-9edition skill.

- Covers 66 core clinical skills based on the 9th edition of "Neurology" by People's Medical Publishing House.
- Includes skills in cerebrovascular diseases, neurodegeneration, cognition, epilepsy, neuromuscular disorders, neuroimaging, electrophysiology, and more.
- Organized skill registry for quick access across neurology and neurosurgery subfields.
- Clinical scenarios range from stroke management, neuroemergencies, dementia, epilepsy, myopathies, to advanced diagnostic interpretation.
